title: Jazz Funk
tagline: Improvising jazz musicians locked into a deep, danceable funk groove.
summary: Jazz funk brings jazz improvisation together with the syncopated grooves and electric instrumentation of funk. The style grew in the late 1960s and 1970s as musicians explored electric keyboards, amplified bass, and rhythm-first arrangements. It influenced fusion, soul-jazz, hip-hop sampling, and later dance music.

pillars.name: Herbie Hancock
pillars.why: Hancock's electric-era recordings connected jazz improvisation with deep funk rhythms and synthesizers.

pillars.name: The Headhunters
pillars.why: The Headhunters brought an influential ensemble groove to Hancock's jazz-funk explorations.

pillars.name: Donald Byrd
pillars.why: Byrd helped popularize a groove-oriented jazz sound through influential collaborations and recordings.
